items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you get Uncle's name? Professor Tom LeBlanc. Yes.

ctx.x: His father was a musician too, old man McCullum. He'd been a musician. He was a musician too. What was his name? George McCullum. Another George. Yes, he was a George McCullum. Yes, he was a George McCullum. Yes. His father was a musician too. But now I can't tell you that much about him. Yeah, that's for sure I know. I had a four-hour instrument. But I knew he always said, the old man always said, come on, he was there. He played the carnette too. But I really know about my uncle teaching George and him. Yes.…
Did you get Uncle's name? Professor Tom LeBlanc. Yes.
How do you spell him LeBlanc for sure?
